C1241.title: FBI Reports Synthetic Identity Fraud as Fastest-Growing Financial Crime in the US
C1241.summary: In January 2020, the FBI reported that synthetic identity fraud had become the fastest-growing financial crime in the United States, with banks and financial institutions losing up to $20 billion that year. Criminals combine real and fabricated personal information to create entirely new identities, which are then used to open fake accounts, make fraudulent purchases, or launder money.
